product.ingredients_text:
Brown rice flour, sesame seeds, potato starch, flax seeds, olive oil, amaranth seeds, quinoa seeds, chia seeds, sea salt, tamari soy sauce powder (tamari soy sauce [soybeans, salt], maltodextrin, salt), millet. 

Contains: sesame, soy. 

Produced in a facility that also uses milk and tree nuts.
